/camera/active.description: Camera preview is running (false = paused / permission missing; not modelled as a ui_state in the pilot)

/document/name.description: Name of the missing document type

/flow/error_class.description: error_class of the last transition taken that has one; set by the engine (week 0 adds)

/launch/uri.description: Request URI from the scanned QR code or the openid4vp:// deep link (week 0 adds: flow context)

/links/help.description: In-app route to help with the details of this error (prototype anchor; the press is HELP)

/request/attempted.description: The user pressed Pokračovať while nothing was selected (error is shown only after such an attempt, REV-001 F-05)

/request/attributes.description: Requested items of the eDoklad, in request order — label copy id, holder value that would be shared, mandatory/optional, and the current tick of an optional item (unticked by default, ARF 5.02 §3 L320). Any request shape is this list with other data (REV-001 F-09); EL-attribute-list renders mandatory items first.

/request/channel.description: How the request reached the wallet: cross-device (QR from another device, BRF-001) | same-device (a link or a Digital Credentials API request from an app or browser on this phone, BRF-004); drives the service-line label

/request/document_name.description: Name of the eDoklad (attestation) the requested data come from (REV-001 F-24)

/request/selected_count.description: Number of items that would be shared (mandatory + ticked optional)

/request/selected_summary.description: Labels of the items that would be sent (mandatory + ticked optional), in request order

/request/selection.description: Ids of the items that would be shared (week 0 adds: derived)

/request/transport.description: Same device: redirect (OpenID4VP link; the wallet posts the response itself) | dc-api (Digital Credentials API: the browser / OS handed the request over and takes the response back when the wallet step finishes — no address from the relying party is opened). REV-006 H-01, DEC-035

/response/status.description: What the wallet has sent the verifier: none (nothing — request not loaded or not authenticated, or failed before a response) | denial (the single as-if-absent answer for refusal, cancellation, missing / invalid document and missing device security, RPA_11, DEC-036) | data (presentation delivered, confirmed by the response endpoint) | unknown (sending started, delivery not confirmed). REV-006 H-02 / H-04 / H-05

/return/url.description: Redirect transport only: the redirect_uri the verifier's response endpoint returned AFTER the wallet posted its response (status data or denial), kept only if https (DEC-033). It is not a field of the request: null when nothing was posted, the endpoint returned none, or with the Digital Credentials API (the hand-back replaces it). REV-006 H-02

/verification/code.description: Code the user retypes on the verifier page (app field `pin`)

/verifier/name.description: Verifier trade name from the access certificate (trusted); for an unauthenticated verifier only the name it claims

/verifier/portal_url.description: Verifier portal URL from the authorization request

/verifier/privacy_url.description: Verifier privacy-policy URL (RPA_10); optional in the request

/verifier/reason.description: Intended use as stated by the verifier

/verifier/service_name.description: Service trade name from the access certificate (RPA_06)

/verifier/trust.description: Relying-party authentication result: trusted | untrusted (untrusted = authentication failed for any reason, incl. access certificate not chaining to a LoTE trust anchor — RPA_04/RPA_05)

scan.description: Camera step; scanning completes automatically. A code that is not a presentation request is rejected here; a usable code moves on to loading the request.

connecting.description: The wallet fetches the request, authenticates the relying party and checks the requested eDoklady before the request screen opens (visible system status, REV-001 F-12). The user may cancel; nothing has been shared.

request.description: Authenticated verifier, request with mandatory items — who asks, why, which data of which eDoklad; continue or refuse. Ticking optional items is local screen state (TOGGLE_ITEM is not a flow transition here).

request-optional-only.description: Request with optional items only, nothing ticked yet — neutral instruction, no error on first view (REV-001 F-05).

request-no-selection.description: Pokračovať was pressed with nothing ticked — the no-field error is shown and the request stays open (pressing Pokračovať again changes nothing); ticking an item clears the error, Odmietnuť refuses.

request-optional-selected.description: Optional-only request with at least one item ticked — Pokračovať proceeds to authentication.

request-untrusted.description: Relying-party authentication failed — RPA_05 notice, claimed name labelled unverified; Pokračovať goes to the explicit-approval step, never straight to authentication (DEC-002, provisional).

untrusted-confirm.description: Explicit approval for an unverified verifier (RPA_06a choice, RPA_07b) — Odmietnuť is the primary action, the approval is secondary (DEC-002, provisional).

auth.description: System biometric prompt over the authentication screen. App order — the user authenticates after Pokračovať; this deviates from RPA_08 (DEC-001, provisional), so no transition claims RPA_08.

auth-not-enrolled.description: Device has no biometrics / screen lock — nothing is released; the user can open the device security settings or close (no detour through the cancelled outcome, REV-001 F-14). 'Získať pomoc' opens help with the error details (to-help).

auth-failed.description: Biometric failed or interrupted — try again or cancel. 'Získať pomoc' opens help with the error details (to-help).

verification-code.description: Check the verifier page and retype the code; send or cancel.

sending.description: The response is being sent; success is shown only once delivery is confirmed (REV-001 F-12). Not interruptible — the response is already being submitted, so no cancel is offered (TPL-progress without action).

document-missing.description: Requested document not in the wallet — add it or close. 'Získať pomoc' opens help with the error details (to-help).

error.description: Generic error — scan a new QR code (the old one may be used up) or close. 'Získať pomoc' opens help with the error details (to-help).

error-expired.description: Request expired — request it again on the verifier page and scan the new QR code, or close. 'Získať pomoc' opens help with the error details (to-help).

error-invalid-qr.description: Unusable QR code — scan again or close. 'Získať pomoc' opens help with the error details (to-help).

exit.note: Wallet home; the verifier website continues the user's session
Device security settings (biometrics / screen lock); the presentation is abandoned, nothing was released
Help and support with the details of this error (FLW-app-info help-from-error, BRF-017); the presentation is abandoned, nothing was released

offline-loading.description: No network: wait, then retry the request (D8-offline shape, M5b test copy)
